exposure: intraoperative fentanyl average effect site concentration
intraoperative hydromorphone average effect site concentration
outcome: New chronic pain diagnoses at 3 months
cohort: 61,249 adult patients who underwent noncardiac surgery with general anesthesia
finding: Increased intraoperative fentanyl and hydromorphone doses were associated with reduced postoperative pain and opioid requirements, potentially leading to better long-term outcomes related to pain and opioid dependence.
